dialogues.speaker: Shahin
dialogues.text: People here are really bad at keeping a conversation going, so lame.

dialogues.speaker: Shahin
dialogues.text: Oh, hello! I rarely meet anyone here who would start a conversation with me.

dialogues.speaker: Shahin
dialogues.text: Great hero, where are you from? What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Shahin
dialogues.text: I'm not making this up, the people in this garden are so boring. All they ever say to a question is "I don't know," "I'm not sure," and "Stop asking about it."

dialogues.speaker: Shahin
dialogues.text: I expected working away from the city to be fun, but accepting work in the city with the Corps of Thirty seems much better now.

dialogues.speaker: Shahin
dialogues.text: Huh, are you ignoring me too?

dialogues.speaker: Shahin
dialogues.text: They're the biggest group of the Eremites in Sumeru, and they mainly focus on work in Sumeru City. Even the color of their clothes isn't the same as ours, they look so much more stylish.

dialogues.speaker: Shahin
dialogues.text: I don't know why they're called the Corps of Thirty, I've seen far more of them than that.

dialogues.speaker: Shahin
dialogues.text: Maybe it's because they frequently collaborate with the Akademiya, and that air of seriousness has rubbed off on them, so I don't really like them.

dialogues.speaker: Shahin
dialogues.text: *sigh* What's the point of saying all of that... Aren't I working for the Akademiya too... Haha...

dialogues.speaker: Shahin
dialogues.text: Luckily, I'm not anywhere near the sages, so I have a little more freedom.
